title: iOS action error recovery
lede: Failed actions remain visible in the active screen, with entered dates preserved.

stats.n: Extension failure and event failure after confirmation
Error placement, accessibility, and booking snapshot contracts

sections.heading: Failure presentation
sections.note: Same iPhone 16 Pro, theme, fixture scenarios, and scripted actions. Baseline uses the exact pre-task working files. Clock and relative booking timestamps differ by one minute; no pixel-density claim is made. The extension baseline is a frame from the UI-test recording because its off-screen error failed the visibility assertion.

pairs.title: Booking extension
pairs.sub: A rejected extension must not look like an ignored tap.
pairs.beforeCap: The error is below the graphical date picker and outside the viewport.
pairs.afterCap: Full error stays above the form; dismissing it retains the selected date.

pairs.title: Event actions after confirmation
pairs.sub: Assignment removal exercises the same failure presenter used by shift claims.
pairs.beforeCap: A second modal alert offers direct mutation retry. This baseline did display the alert; suppression was not reproduced.
pairs.afterCap: A persistent banner offers authoritative Refresh and Dismiss without another modal.

changes.was: Extension and call-window errors lived within scrolling form content.
changes.now: Both pin a full, VoiceOver-announced error above the form and preserve input.

changes.was: Event actions attempted an error alert after confirmation and offered replay.
changes.now: A pinned recovery banner refreshes the latest crew state before another attempt.

verification: Two isolated UI tests passed; extension dismissal preserves the changed date and a repeated rejection is shown again.
Six focused regression checks passed; project consistency, iOS drift, and audit-gap checks passed.
Broader related source contracts have existing failures in version, Schedule authoring, picker, and dashboard expectations; see the plan.
notes: Local source and fixture proof only. No production booking or shift was mutated; no commit, upload, or deployment occurred.
Student claim backend rejection causes and physical-device VoiceOver behavior remain unverified.
Call-window error placement is source/build checked; this page does not claim a call-window runtime capture.
